introHtml: Cotton cables and cords offer a soft, comfortable feel that synthetic materials can't match, making them ideal for lanyards and badge holders worn all day. Unlike nylon or polyester, cotton breathes and lies flat against the skin, reducing irritation. For corporate events, trade shows, or employee ID systems, custom cotton cables and cords provide a natural look and a professional finish that reflects attention to detail. Decorate with screen printing or woven labels for a subtle brand presence.
